Business on Main Street

Two kinds of customer, one brand.

Downtown Stillwater on the St. Croix and downtown White Bear Lake are full of independent shops, salons, galleries and studios, and most of them serve two audiences: the weekend visitor deciding where to walk in, and the neighbor deciding where to come back.

The visitor usually finds you on a phone before they find your door. The neighbor needs a reason to choose you over the shop next door. A brand that speaks to both on purpose is a positioning decision, and it is what the Strategy Day is for.

Also working with businesses in Stillwater, White Bear Lake, Bayport, Mahtomedi and Hugo.

  • Beautiful in person, lost online

    Your storefront is lovely. If your website does not match it, the visitor searching from the coffee shop walks somewhere else.

  • Busy summers, quiet winters

    When the visitors go home, the brand has to bring the locals back.

  • Premium inside, ordinary online

    If the experience is premium, every touchpoint has to say so before the customer reaches the counter.

The Strategy Day

One day to decide.

For the business that needs a decision more than a build. We work through four things in order, and by the end of the day the hardest questions about your brand have answers, in writing.

  1. Audit

    What is working, what is not, and why: your website, your offers, your reviews and how you describe the business today.

  2. Discovery

    Who you serve best, who you want more of, and what they are choosing between when they find you.

  3. Positioning

    The one clear decision: who the business is for and what it should be known for.

  4. Message

    The words to say it, on your website, in a conversation and in a search result.

Questions

Before you book.

Something not here? Ask me directly. I answer every one myself.

Do you meet in person in Stillwater or White Bear Lake?

Yes. Both are a short drive from my base in Forest Lake, so a Strategy Day can be in person or remote.

Is a Strategy Day worth it for a small shop?

It is built for one. A small business has the least room for a brand that says the wrong thing, and $1,500 for the decisions costs less than a website built on a guess.

Can you help people find us on Google?

Yes, as part of a website. Every site I build includes the copy and search foundations, so the people looking for what you sell can find you.

How much does it cost?

A Strategy Day is $1,500 flat. Websites start at $4,000, and a Full Brand Launch starts at $15,000.
